title: A Message From the Boss
content: Science-fiction satire for adults, work-safe: no nudity, no sex, no gore.

style.look: A cinematic photoreal frame of hard science fiction aboard an austere starship of an ascetic far-future empire: matte black and bare pale ceramic surfaces, flush seams, even white strip light, razor-thin holographic displays, extreme plainness, no ornament, no neon, no clutter. The only marking anywhere is one small plain black gear symbol.

cast.name: YOKE
cast.description: the ship's AI. She is a HOLOGRAM and the only drawn thing in a photoreal room: a waist-up projection rendered as a flat-colour anime illustration with crisp linework, glowing pale blue, slightly translucent, with faint scan lines. An adult woman of about twenty-four with a calm, intelligent face, long straight pale silver hair with a faint blue tint falling well past her shoulders, a side-swept fringe, amber-gold eyes, fair skin, one small plain black gear-shaped hair clip, a plain black high-collared long-sleeved dress with a narrow white inner collar

cast.name: the Technician
cast.description: a slight young man of about twenty-five, photoreal, always seen from behind: untidy dark hair, a stylus tucked behind his right ear, a plain black high-collared uniform with a narrow white collar, the sleeves pushed up to the elbows. His face is never shown

cast.name: Supervisor Barnabas
cast.description: an uplifted dog who is a bureaucrat of the empire, photoreal: a golden retriever with a kind, eager, trusting face, sitting upright at a desk like a person, both front paws resting neatly on the desk, wearing a plain black high-collared uniform jacket with a narrow white inner collar and nothing else: no badge, no medal, no insignia
cast.sheet: A lifelike photograph, the look of hard science fiction: a still from a video call. Supervisor Barnabas, an uplifted dog who is a bureaucrat of an ascetic far-future empire, sits upright at a bare pale desk in a plain grey office, facing the camera, both front paws resting neatly on the desk. He is a golden retriever with a kind, eager, trusting face, wearing a plain black high-collared uniform jacket with a narrow white inner collar and nothing else: no badge, no medal, no insignia. Even soft light. One dog only.

panels.picture: The ship's operations room. YOKE's hologram stands on the black console, waist up, one hand lifted in an offhand 'by the way' gesture, a small amused smile. The Technician stands at the console at the left edge of the frame, seen from behind. The upper left of the frame is plain dark wall.

words.text: Oh, and we got a message from the boss.

panels.picture: A large razor-thin display floats above the console and fills most of the frame: on it, the video call. Supervisor Barnabas sits upright at his desk facing the camera, ears up, mouth open in a delighted grin. At the bottom left edge of the frame, small and dark, the back of the Technician's head as he watches.
panels.camera: from behind the Technician, the display large in frame

words.text: Technician! Supervisor Barnabas here, Clearance Office, Sector Nine.

panels.picture: Close on the display: Supervisor Barnabas leans toward the camera, holding up a thin report tablet proudly in both front paws, eyes bright, tail a blur behind his chair.

words.text: I just read your first field report, and I want you to know I read the whole thing. Twice!

panels.picture: The display again: Supervisor Barnabas sits very straight, one front paw raised solemnly like a speaker making an official point, his expression earnest and serious. The right third of the frame is the plain grey wall of his office.

words.text: The Board says only the numbers matter, and the Board is very wise.
But I say you are a good egg.

panels.picture: The display, close: Supervisor Barnabas beams at the camera, tongue out, eyes squeezed half shut with happiness, one paw reaching toward the lens to end the call.

words.text: Keep it up! I will be watching every report. I love reports.
Good boy. Good work! Good work. Barnabas out.

panels.picture: The operations room again, the display gone dark. YOKE's hologram on the console turns to the Technician with a wry, fond half-smile, one eyebrow up, a hand on her hip. The Technician, seen from behind at the left edge of the frame, has not moved.

words.text: A dog for a boss. Lucky you, honestly, they're lovely.
Just don't let him anywhere near the budget.
